page.overview:
Who is Douglas Hein?

General Douglas Hein is the main antagonist of Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within. A dedicated military general who lost his wife and child to the Phantom threat, General Hein is determined to destroy the Phantoms, using whatever means necessary. He is voiced by James Woods.

Having been born one year before the Leonid Meteor crashed to Earth, Hein grew up during some of the most tumultuous years of the crisis and became focused on finding a way to end the Phantom threat.

Hein is an average-looking, middle aged man with short, swept back black hair and pale blue eyes. He wears a black turtleneck shirt under a long unfastened leather coat. The coat has decorative pieces akin of his military rank. He wears a wide belt and black leather gloves.

Focused, intelligent and cunning, the loss of his wife and child has driven Hein in his pursuit to destroy the Phantoms. Some would say his focused determination has turned into obsession that completely blinded him from seeing the harm his actions are causing. He presents himself as a calm, reasonable military man who values logic and loyalty rather than fantastical and whimsical theories, as shown when he disbelieved the theory of Gaia and even mocked the theory when Aki tried to get him to stop firing the Zeus Cannon at the end. He is not sadistic, as shown when he was outright horrified when his plans ended up in the deaths of most of his own soldiers, muttering “What have I done?” He is shown to have signs of severe depression that worsened to the point of developing suicidal tendencies, as he had attempted to shoot himself in the head after escaping his ship’s destruction as it was invaded by the Phantoms, and during the final part of the film, where he purposefully disregarded warnings from his own staff and even the alarms from the Zeus Cannon to try to force it to fire the Zeus Cannon even after specific warnings about it overheating and overloading, resulting in the ship exploding and destroying the entire cannon, presumably with him still inside.
